import requests

def inspect_protein(acc):
    data = requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.json").json()
    gene = data.get('genes', [{}])[0].get('geneName', {}).get('value')
    protein_name = data.get('proteinDescription', {}).get('recommendedName', {}).get('fullName', {}).get('value')
    seq = data.get('sequence', {})
    print(f"Gene: {gene}")
    print(f"Accession: {acc}")
    print(f"Protein: {protein_name}")
    print(f"Length: {seq.get('length')} aa")
    print(f"Mass: {seq.get('molWeight')} Da ({seq.get('molWeight')/1000:.3f} kDa)")

inspect_protein("P18627") # LAG3
print("-" * 40)
inspect_protein("Q9Y5C1") # ANGPTL3

import requests

def check_isoforms(acc):
    url = f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.json"
    data = requests.get(url).json()
    comments = data.get('comments', [])
    isoform_comments = [c for c in comments if c.get('commentType') == 'ALTERNATIVE PRODUCTS']
    print(f"Isoforms for {acc}:", isoform_comments)

check_isoforms("P18627")
check_isoforms("Q9Y5C1")
